parts.official_mark_scheme_text:
$P(R)=4/36=1/9$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt at $P(R)$ by probability-space diagram or listing more than half the options; must see a probability, just a list is not enough.
$P(T)=P(O,E)+P(E,O)=1/4+1/4=1/2$ OR $P(R\mid T)=1/9$ — M1. Guidance: Attempt at $P(T)$ or $P(R\mid T)$ involving more than half the options.
$P(R\cap T)=P(3,4)+P(4,3)=2/36=1/18$ OR $P(R\mid T)=1/9$ — B1. Guidance: Value stated, not from $P(R)\times P(T)$, e.g. from probability-space diagram.
As $P(R)\times P(T)=P(R\cap T)$ OR as $P(R\mid T)=P(R)$ — M1. Guidance: Comparing product values with $P(R\cap T)$, or comparing $P(R\mid T)$ with $P(R)$.
The events are independent — A1. Guidance: Correct conclusion must have all probabilities correct.
Total: 5.
